reviews.title: most annoying app i’ve ever used
reviews.text:
10/10 for planning. 1/10 for all the bugs - it generally can’t even scroll down your planned feed without freezing or crashing. it’s hard to swap and move photos without freezing or crashing. it freezes or crashes when doing anything it’s meant to do which is really irritating.

all of my photos are already saved and planned on here tho so i don’t want to use another app but if i could go back in time and choose another planner i would.

reviews.title: NOT WORTH IT AT ALL!!
reviews.text: Im so disappointed! I used to love this app but after this new update, I wasnt able to log into preview because I had a private account and even when i made my account public, I wasnt able to build my collage/carousel for my instagram before uploading straight to my account. Also there are so many other apps that I can use to do the same features as I can now! The app is definitely not worth the money that I am paying (£48) 😭 i will be cancelling my subscription, so sad to have wasted my money, I wouldn’t have ever re subscribed if i knew the app had changed so much with much fewer features than the last time i used it.
